programs.title: Life-stage age groups by sex
programs.description: Groups Age into five public-health life stages and runs FREQ within Sex.
programs.source:
DEFINE AgeGroup TEXTINPUT "Age group"
RECODE Age TO AgeGroup
  LOVALUE - 4 = "0-4"
  4 - 17 = "5-17"
  17 - 44 = "18-44"
  44 - 64 = "45-64"
  64 - HIVALUE = "65+"
END
FREQ AgeGroup STRATAVAR=Sex

programs.title: Broad age bands by case status
programs.description: Compares child, adult, and older-adult bands within the foodborne Case Status categories.
programs.source:
DEFINE BroadAgeGroup TEXTINPUT "Broad age group"
RECODE Age TO BroadAgeGroup
  LOVALUE - 17 = "0-17"
  17 - 64 = "18-64"
  64 - HIVALUE = "65+"
END
FREQ BroadAgeGroup STRATAVAR=case_status

programs.title: Age distribution by decade
programs.description: Creates decade-width age categories and runs an overall frequency table without stratification.
programs.source:
DEFINE AgeDecade TEXTINPUT "Age decade"
RECODE Age TO AgeDecade
  LOVALUE - 9 = "0-9"
  9 - 19 = "10-19"
  19 - 29 = "20-29"
  29 - 39 = "30-39"
  39 - 49 = "40-49"
  49 - 59 = "50-59"
  59 - 69 = "60-69"
  69 - HIVALUE = "70+"
END
FREQ AgeDecade

programs.title: Potato salad by case status
programs.description: Runs an unstratified categorical TABLES analysis with counts, percentages, expected counts, Pearson, and bounded Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact testing.

programs.title: Binary TABLES Single Table Analysis
programs.description: Exercises the legacy automatic 2 x 2 branch, including OR, RR, RD, chi-square, mid-p, and Fisher results from the validated Rust/WebAssembly kernel.

programs.title: Complete DIALOG tour
programs.description: Interactively exercises all 14 supported DIALOG types and both implicit and explicit numeric syntax, then downloads the active records with WRITE. UNDEFINE * first resets Standard session variables so the tour can be rerun; entered values are omitted from command history.
programs.source:
UNDEFINE *
DEFINE ReviewAge NUMERIC
DEFINE ReviewText TEXTINPUT
DEFINE ReviewFlag YN
DEFINE ReviewDate DATEFORMAT
DEFINE ReviewTime TIMEFORMAT
DEFINE ReviewDateTime DATETIMEFORMAT
DIALOG "Review the complete foodborne DIALOG exercise" TITLETEXT="Foodborne DIALOG tour"
DIALOG "Enter the age to review using implicit numeric input" ReviewAge
DIALOG "Enter the age to review" ReviewAge NUMERIC TITLETEXT="Foodborne review"
DIALOG "Enter a reviewer note" ReviewText TEXTINPUT
DIALOG "Continue the review?" ReviewFlag YN
DIALOG "Choose the review date" ReviewDate DATEFORMAT "YYYY-MM-DD"
DIALOG "Choose the review time" ReviewTime TIMEFORMAT "HH:MM"
DIALOG "Choose the review date and time" ReviewDateTime DATETIMEFORMAT "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"
DIALOG "Choose a case status" ReviewText "Confirmed", "Probable", "Suspected", "Not a case"
DIALOG "Choose a case status from project data" ReviewText DBVALUES [Foodborne Outbreak Investigation Form] case_status
DIALOG "Choose a project form" ReviewText DBVIEWS
DIALOG "Choose a project" ReviewText DATABASES
DIALOG "Choose a defined variable" ReviewText DBVARIABLES
DIALOG "Choose a CSV" ReviewText READ "*.csv"
DIALOG "Review an export name (DIALOG exercise only)" ReviewText WRITE "*.csv"
WRITE REPLACE "Text" {foodborne-dialog-tour-export-copy.csv}:foodborne_dialog_tour_export_copy#csv *
